bio: It's no wonder people that love to eat here! In addition to its fine dining restaurant, Hotel Hirsch has its Dorfstube, which is a great option for fans of Swabian cuisine. In the cosy old dining space, completely done out in wood, you can tuck into specialities such as tripe, maultaschen and Zwiebelrostbraten (roast beef with onions). Vegetarian options are also on the menu. The delicious dishes are all made using regional produce. Friendly service. We highly recommend staying overnight. The guestrooms are really lovely and inviting....
